description: Checks one URL without downloading the page: HTTP status, the full redirect chain hop by hop with the code of each, the final URL, whether it ends on HTTPS, content type and size, and the security headers the server sends. Built for going through a list of links one at a time. No API key, no account. $0.005 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

method.description: HEAD (default) or GET. Some servers refuse HEAD and only answer GET.

url.description: The URL to check. http and https only; private and loopback addresses are refused.

name: web_status
title: URL status and redirect chain
